text: First thing in the morning I walk the line and check every machine is ready to run before we start.
Pagi-pagi saya periksa mesin dan pastikan semua selamat sebelum mula kerja.
Before power on I do my pre-use checks on the guards, the oil level and the emergency stop.
Saya buat pemeriksaan rutin sebelum hidupkan mesin setiap hari.
I read the night shift notes and the logbook so I know what happened while I was away.
Sebelum mula saya baca nota serahan syif malam dan buku log.
At handover I write down open work orders and anything the next shift must watch.
I write the temperature and pressure in the log every hour.
Setiap jam saya catat bacaan suhu dan tekanan dalam rekod.
I record meter readings in a spreadsheet and check them against the limits.
I monitor the process data on the screen and log anything outside the range.
When the alarm stops the line I trace the cause step by step until I find the broken part.
Bila mesin berhenti saya cari punca kerosakan, periksa dari sensor sampai ke wayar.
Last month a conveyor kept tripping. I checked the supply, the contactor and found the overload had tripped.
I diagnose why a machine produces defects, then fix the setting or call maintenance.
The drive showed a fault code so I looked it up in the inverter manual and reset the parameters.
Inverter trip, saya baca kod kerosakan VFD dan semak motor.
I test the variable frequency drive and check the motor current when it trips.
Before I open a panel I switch off, lock it, put my tag on it and test that it is dead.
Saya buat lockout tagout dan pastikan tiada arus sebelum buka kabinet.
We always isolate the breaker and keep the key with us while we work on the machine.
I never work on a live circuit; I isolate the supply and prove it dead first.
I use a multimeter to check voltage and continuity on the circuit.
Saya guna meter untuk ukur voltan dan semak kesinambungan wayar.
I probe the terminals with the tester to find which cable has no continuity.
I pull cable, run conduit and wire the control panel following the drawing.
Saya buat pendawaian panel dan sambung kabel mengikut lukisan.
I terminate wires, label the circuits and tidy the cabling inside the cabinet.
I read the circuit diagram to see where a relay connects before I touch anything.
Saya baca lukisan skematik dan gambar rajah litar untuk faham sambungan.
I follow the blueprint and the electrical drawing when I install a new line.
I check the ladder logic on the PLC to see which input is not coming on.
Saya boleh baca program PLC dan ubah sedikit logik tangga.
I connect the laptop to the controller and watch the inputs and outputs live.
The proximity sensor was out of position so I adjusted the bracket and tested it.
Sensor fotoelektrik tidak mengesan, saya bersihkan dan laraskan semula.
I replace faulty sensors and check the signal before I restart the machine.
New operators come to me and I show them how to start the machine safely.
Saya ajar pekerja baru cara kendali mesin dan beri taklimat keselamatan.
I mentor the apprentices and guide them through their first repairs.
On a product change I swap the tooling, set up the jig and run a test piece.
Tukar produk, saya tukar acuan dan laraskan tetapan mesin.
I do the changeover and fixture setup between batches.
I inspect parts for defects, measure with a micrometer and record the sampling results.
Saya buat pemeriksaan visual, periksa kecacatan dan ukur dimensi dengan mikrometer.
I calibrate the gauges first and then check a sample from every lot.
I drive the forklift and stack pallets in the high bay racking.
Saya pandu forklift, susun palet dan lakukan memunggah barang dengan selamat.
Before using the forklift I check the forks, the tyres and the horn, then keep the aisle clear.
I mostly type invoices and update spreadsheets in the office.
I answer phone calls and book meeting rooms for the managers.
Saya jaga kaunter dan jawab pertanyaan pelanggan.
I am still studying and have not done any work on a machine yet.
I help the team with lunch orders and clean the break room.
